agent_explanation: With dt~0.02 and sensor_noise~0.017 at near-max, the state-feedback controller receives noisy theta/omega measurements. Starting theta=0.1, it applies incorrect forces up to 24N, pumping energy from 1.28J to 17J. Pole diverges: theta goes 0.034 at step5, -0.257 at step10, -0.724 at step14, -0.867 at step15 violating 0.8 limit. Removing only noise makes same plant stable with no violation, proving noise-induced misestimation + coarse integration is cause.
